book.name: Luke
book.title: Luke ka Te Pabe'e Jesus, Te Naa Tooa'a-witu, Numu oo Tuukwena

content: Tu nanesootuhi tabeba-wi mu Pharisee nanesootuhidu moohedu ka Te Pabe'e tuka bi. Soo Te Pabe'e yise umu-no tuka, mu Pharisee oo e ya'epunne ka Te Pabe'e nesootzemakwuse.
Sumu'yoo nana tookoo pawadu oo numu-no.
Soo Te Pabe'e oo poonne ka umu Pharisee yoo Jew tumayohope sopedakwadoodu tubenga, “Ha'yoo soo mumme tumayohope? Besa'yoo, gi hownne'yoo haa'a ka nanesootuhi tabeno soo numu namabesakuna?”
Pana umu gi oo nanekwegea. Soo Te Pabe'e yise ka tookoo pawadu nana tzamahoose oo mabesakuse oo nobe-kwitoo oo ta'ya.

Ka mu Pharisee yise mee netamma, “Ka nanesootuhi tabeno mu dooa tawaga-kwitoo wuehoose, tooetoo mu kootsoo, ka gi hownnekoo oo tzeboo'e, mu puu oo tummatzikwu. Mu sakwa yise gi e nesootzemapana ka nana e tummatza'e.”
Umu Pharisee gi hanotoosoo ha'yoo unne-wa'ne'yoo.
Soo Te Pabe'e mu poonne ka susumudu mu numu nadukabidu besa nasooyugwena ka besow kadunoo-kwitu mooe ohomanakwe, oosoo yise mee mu netamma,
“Tamme ka na'ewa tuka-kwitoo tamme tubise, tamme sakwa gi besa nasooyugwena besa-kwitoo mooe ohomanepana. Tamme ka besow kadunoo-kwi mooe kaduhoose sumuna saa'a tamme ooonakwa besa'yoo oe petuhookwu.
Soo numu oetoo te tuka bidu yise mee te netammakwu, ‘Yaa e besa pua'a petuhoo. U sakwa ookow kadunoo maka.’ Tamme yise sumuna gi besa oo nakwumakukwu ka oekoo tamme tu tayahoose.

Ka tamme tubise, tamme sakwa gi ka hemma besa-kwitoo mooe ohomanepana. Soo numu te tuka bidu te manena poonnena sumuna mee te netammakwu, ‘U e besa pua'a yaa ka besa kadunoo-kwi katuse ka e pupua'a-baa, umu-no tuka.’ ‘Oosoo besa'yoo numu,’ mee umu numu oo manepunnedu, te sootubetseyina.
Tamme ka tammesoo besa nasooyugwena, saa'a namanasookwikudooa. Tamme ka gi besa nasooyugwena saa'a, ‘Oosoo besa'yoo,’ mee nanetammakwu.”

Soo Te Pabe'e yise ka nana pumme tuka bidu meeoo netamma, “Tamme ka na'ewa tukana, tamme sakwa tutuha manedu, mu gi yutsungadu numu oetu bi tuungu. Umuoo gi hownnekoo ooonnekoo soo te tumakodyuku-wa'ne'yoo. Saa'a yise ka Te Naa te ya'e-wikoo tamme oo mayodase, te tumakodyuku-kwi tamme nasootuhikwu. Pana tamme ka tu pupua'amu te nananumu, yise ka besa manepunnedu te nanumu suu'mu tuka bise, umu saa'a punno'o te tuka bikwu, umuoo yise mooasoo te tumakodyukukute. Saa'a soo Te Naa gi ooonekwitoo te sootuhi-wa'ne'yoo.”
Sumu'yoo numu ka Te Pabe'e-no tukana meeoo, “Mu numu ka Te Naa-no'yoona ewa besa nasootuhikwu mu ewa tukadu besa sokwamakwu.”
Soo Te Pabe'e ka Te Naa paba ewa tuka-kwitu yise ka nana natukwenguna, “Sumu'yoo numu tu pupua'amu makakwuse mee soonammena,
ewa yongo saa tuungu, ewow tu pupua'amu oetoo bi.
Pana mu oo pupua'amu mee oo sooyugwena sukwe nanemaweakooha sumu'yoo oo pua'a mee oo netamma, ‘Nu ka tubewabe heetoo'ase, nu oo tasootzemahookwu.’
Sumu'yoo punno'o meeoo, ‘Nu sumumano (10) kootsoo tumuhoose, nu umuoo poopoonnegakwu.’
Oosoo sumu'yoo punno'o meeoo, ‘Nu gi kemma-wa'ne meno'o manepunne, nu pudu nodukwadoohoose.’

Soo oo tayana ka kodyu petuse, ‘Umu gi kemmow-wa'ne meno'o manepunne,’ meeoo oo tuukwe. Soo nana suda oo nakwumaku ka ewa tukooma hane tuunguse tu pupua'amu gi kemma. Ka pumme tummatzidu yise mee netamma, ‘Manatutooe mu numu nemasumudoodooa, tooe hownnekoo tooe, mu tutuha manedu, mu gi unu besa mamanemodu nokosoo gi tutubootabuedu, tooe hownnekoo tooe umu ewa tukoohane, umu nu-no tukakwu.’
Saa'a mu numu oo bi petuse mee oo netamma, ‘Nu mooasoo nuka u netamma-kwa'ne manese sapa, ewowsoo tamme soogwa'e. Gisoo u nobe kaa'no.’
Soo nana yise ka pumme tummatzidu tayasoo too meeoo netamma, ‘U sakwa manatutooe mu numu masumudoo, yise e nobe kaanohookwu.
Pana umu numu mooe'ugasoo e too'e bina umu gi nu-baatu yongo tuka-wa'ne'yoo.’ ”
Ewa'yoo numu ka Te Pabe'e-nakwi meadape. Soo Te Pabe'e yooihoose umu-tamme nakwumunase mee mu netamma,

“Mu nuka no'okosoo hemma-ooonakwa unu soowabega. Mu sakwa ka mu naa, mu pea, mu nodukwa noko mu doodooamu, mu samoomu, muusoo sapa tuwow nuka mu-ooonakwa unu soowabega, o'no mu ka E Naa besa podo meadabekwu.
Mu nu-koobatoo nasoomawunise tooe mu nabatsase sapa, o'no mu nu-no'yookwu.
Mooe'ugasoo gisoo ka Te Naa besa podo meana, tamme sakwa oetu soohane, tamme haa'a tooe oo mane-wa'ne'yoo?
Soo numu puu ka nobe-tookwuse ka gi oo nanenagakwuna mooe soohanena sukwe nobe-tookoohase, ona manikese, tukwumehoe petugase yise oto oo matusookwuni. O'no yise mu numu oo-ma'yoona nanekoe.
‘Ma how manedu masoo? Masoo sakwa uga mitu soohanese, o'no yise uga nobe-too.’
Tamme sakwa nakobenatusoo soohanena ka na'akwebu moohedu-wa'ne, oosoo tu manikwuna puu mooe soohanese numu-no nagoekwu.
Oosoo ka mu tubetse ewow, ka gi mu matzooeku-wa'ne manepunnena, oosoo yise umu-no oetu nehanese mu tu pupua'amu-doose sumusoo nanano besa meadabekwu.
Mu ka nu-no'yookwuse mu no'oko mu hee-gana matusookwunikwu, o'no gi hee mu tsitugukwu.
Ongabe puu besa'yoo ka ongakamana. Ka gi ongakama manese, tamme gi hownnekoo oo madi-wa'ne'yoo.

Oosoo gi he-toogoo besa'yoo ka gi kamana, tamme oo totsakwatekwuna'e. Ooosoo tamme ka Te Naa besa podo meadabena, ka te kammana kadoo manepetugase, Te Naa te totsakwatekwuna'e. Mu sakwa e nakapunne, o'no mu gi nasootuaganedooa.”
